# CodingPlan.org

> CodingPlan.org compares AI coding subscriptions and token plans for developers in Chinese and English.

## Core Pages

- [Chinese comparison](https://codingplan.org): Nine AI coding platforms with pricing, models, quotas and tools.
- [English comparison](https://codingplan.org/en): Claude Code, GLM, MiniMax, Kimi and Qwen plans.
- [Zhipu GLM](https://codingplan.org/plans/zhipu): GLM models, tiers, rolling quotas and MCP tools.
- [MiniMax](https://codingplan.org/plans/minimax): M3 token plans, concurrency and multimodal quotas.
- [Kimi](https://codingplan.org/plans/kimi): K2.6 plans, member benefits and Agent clusters.
- [Volcengine Ark](https://codingplan.org/plans/volcengine): Multi-model plans and Auto routing.
- [Alibaba Cloud Bailian](https://codingplan.org/plans/aliyun): Qwen and third-party model plan availability.
- [Xiaomi MiMo](https://codingplan.org/plans/xiaomi): Credit-based MiMo token plans.

Prices and quotas can change. Verify current information on each provider's official website.
